cowork_prompt:
Open https://maxime-droux.com/digest/posts.json and schedule the posts listed at the end of this message, and only those. The file holds the shortlist; the list below says which of them I picked and when each one goes out. Match them by `index`. Ignore every other post in the file.

For each post, in order:
- Type the `text` straight through, once, with real keystrokes. Never insert
  text via JavaScript. It already ends with the article URL on its own line,
  so do not add, move or retype the URL separately: typing it last is what makes
  the link preview load the article photo.
- Each post has exactly one @mention. Type `mention.type`, wait for the
  dropdown, click the row matching `mention.expect`. If no row matches, post
  it without the mention rather than tagging the wrong company. LinkedIn will
  render the official name: that is expected and fine, do not fight it, do not
  restart the post, do not rewrite it.
- Schedule it at the date and time given for it in the list below. If no link
  preview appears, schedule it anyway: do not hunt for an image.

Two attempts per post, then stop. If a post is not scheduled after two tries,
leave it, move to the next one, and list it at the end. Never start a third.

Before you start, open the scheduled-posts list once and note what is already
there. Skip any post already scheduled: never schedule the same one twice.

Verification:
- Claims already settled against the article are not in the file. Check only
  what `claims` still lists, and posts with needs_check: true (a figure nobody
  has verified: confirm round closed / round name / amount received / investors
  in THIS round). Both empty and false means schedule it, no research.

Anything that fails: do not schedule it, and do not edit any file or commit
anything. List the held posts at the end with the sentence you read and the
page you read it on, and I will record them.

Report what was scheduled and what was held.
